title: Inventory audits
purpose: Find manual box inventory audits and compare their recorded evidence.

sections.title: Access and actions
paragraphs: Administrators, repository managers and technicians create, complete and cancel audits. Viewers read audits and their results. Accounts without an application role, including superuser accounts without a role, have no access.

These are working product defaults, not repository policy. Audits record evidence only. They never change storage positions, specimen records, quantities, statuses or holds. A discrepancy needs follow-up through the ordinary inventory workflows; it is not a correction.
New inventory audit opens a form for one active box. Select an audit number to open its snapshot and results. Viewers see no mutation controls.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches the frozen box code or creation reason, or an exact audit number such as AUD-000001 (also accepts its numeric part). Empty search includes all audits.

items.label: Status
items.description: All statuses is the default. Open means no final result; Completed means every position was observed and results frozen; Cancelled retains a snapshot without observations. Invalid status values display filter errors and no results.

items.label: Apply and Clear all
items.description: Apply runs the current search and filters from the first page. Clear all removes them. Filter chips remove the named filter.

items.label: Sorting and pages
items.description: Newest created audits first by default. Audit, Box and Created headings sort in either direction. Shared pagination offers 25, 50 or 100 rows per page. An invalid page size is rejected; an unknown sort uses the default.

items.label: Audit
items.description: Permanent AUD-prefixed audit number; links to the record.

items.label: Box
items.description: Box code frozen when the audit was created.

items.label: Status
items.description: Open, Completed or Cancelled, determined by the immutable final result.

items.label: Created and Created by
items.description: When the snapshot was recorded, in repository time, and the actor who created it.

items.label: Reason
items.description: The creation reason, shortened in the list. The record retains the full text.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Choose which table columns to show. Audit remains available.

sections.title: Empty and error states
paragraphs: An empty list offers New inventory audit to operators. No results invites you to change or clear filters. Invalid filters explain what to correct.
